notes: Reading ERROR_L ($FFEC) pops the oldest queued error; 0 means the queue is empty.
A full queue drops its oldest unread entry and queues ERROR_QUEUE_OVERFLOW.
MIA_STAT_ERRORS is set while the queue holds an error, and IRQ_ERROR is raised for each one pushed.

errors.name: ERROR_MIA_CANNOT_ALLOCATE_RAM
errors.description: Reserved/startup RAM allocation failure code. Current RAM is statically allocated, so this should not normally occur.

errors.name: ERROR_QUEUE_OVERFLOW
errors.description: Error queue overwrote one or more unread errors.

errors.name: ERROR_DMA_SIZE_ZERO
errors.description: DMA copy requested with a byte count of zero.

errors.name: ERROR_DMA_SRC_WILL_OVERFLOW
errors.description: DMA source range would exceed the 256 KiB MIA RAM region.

errors.name: ERROR_DMA_TGT_WILL_OVERFLOW
errors.description: DMA destination range would exceed the 256 KiB MIA RAM region.

errors.name: ERROR_DMA_QUEUE_FULL
errors.description: A copy could not wait behind the running one: eight were already waiting.

errors.name: ERROR_CMD_QUEUE_FULL
errors.description: Command trigger could not be queued for core 0.

errors.name: ERROR_CTX_OVERFLOW
errors.description: MIA_CTX push with the context stack already four deep. Nothing was saved.

errors.name: ERROR_CTX_UNDERFLOW
errors.description: MIA_CTX pop with nothing saved. Nothing changed.

errors.name: ERROR_INPUT_MODE_UNAVAILABLE
errors.description: Requested input mode is unknown, reserved (2), or not available right now (Wi-Fi without its listener).

errors.name: ERROR_INPUT_PROBE_INVALID
errors.description: Requested input probe id is invalid.

errors.name: ERROR_AUDIO_QUEUE_OVERFLOW
errors.description: Live audio register writes outran the audio IRQ queue; the IRQ resynchronized from RAM.

errors.name: ERROR_SD_BUSY
errors.description: A new SD/FS request was made while another request was running.

errors.name: ERROR_SD_NOT_READY
errors.description: Raw SD command requested before initialization.

errors.name: ERROR_FS_READ_FAILED
errors.description: FAT file read or load failed.

errors.name: ERROR_FS_NO_FILE_OPEN
errors.description: File I/O was requested with no open file.

errors.name: ERROR_FS_HANDLE_ALREADY_OPEN
errors.description: FS_OPEN requested on a handle slot that is already open.

errors.name: ERROR_FS_INVALID_HANDLE
errors.description: SD_HANDLE_SELECT names a slot outside the supported range.
